Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Alexander Nevsky, the director of *Moscow Heat (2004)*, is Russian based solely on the fact that the film is described as a "Russian action film." This oversight led to the incorrect conclusion that the directors of the two films are from different countries, resulting in the wrong solution to the real-world problem.
